Choose it when performance is critical and overlapping transparent surfaces are rare [S2]. [Alpha Clip](alpha-clip.md)

The evidence explicitly states that 'Alpha clip' allows rendering through the opaque pass, which 'avoids some typical issues with transparent surfaces.' It contrasts this with 'Alpha blend,' which has 'limitations when multiple transparent surfaces are rendered behind each other.' This implies that Alpha Clip is the preferred choice when performance is critical (avoiding the complexity/limitations of blending) and overlapping transparent surfaces are rare (since blending struggles with multiple layers, but clipping avoids those specific issues). The claim accurately reflects the trade-offs described in the source.
